For education only; this is not legal, purchasing, financial or safety advice. Stage C compares current results with required results. For each gap, record the target, the observed value, their difference, its practical consequence and the reliability of the evidence. A gap is a finding; a proposal to buy, hire or restructure is a possible response. Do not confuse the two, because an early solution can hide the actual cause.
